name: Assassin

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: Strikes first and hardest: Advantage and extra damage in the first round, poisons and disguises.

feature.name: Assassinate
feature.summary: Advantage on Initiative; first round, Advantage against creatures that haven't acted and Sneak Attack adds your Rogue level.
feature.text: Initiative: you have Advantage on Initiative rolls. Surprising Strikes: during the first round of a combat you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet, and if your Sneak Attack hits during that round the target takes extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your Rogue level.

feature.name: Assassin's Tools
feature.summary: Proficiency with the Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit.
feature.text: You gain a Disguise Kit and a Poisoner's Kit, and proficiency with both.

feature.name: Infiltration Expertise
feature.summary: Mimic voices and handwriting; Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.
feature.text: Masterful Mimicry: after at least an hour studying a person, you can copy their speech, their handwriting or both without fault. Roving Aim: using Steady Aim no longer reduces your Speed to 0.

feature.name: Envenom Weapons
feature.summary: Poison Cunning Strike also deals 2d6 Poison damage that ignores Resistance.

feature.name: Death Strike
feature.summary: First-round Sneak Attack: target makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex + PB) or the attack's damage is doubled.
